messages:
Sam: Posted postmortem for the KV cache instability — root cause looks like coordinated eviction + delayed fallback. Link: https://redwood.notions/pm/kv-cache-2024
IncidentBot: Postmortem created by Sam. Please add remediation owners and timelines.
Neha: I'll own runbook updates. Main ask: make triage steps super-actionable (commands + checks to run within first 5 min).
Oliver: Agreed. I'll draft a small 'first-5-min' checklist and include exact commands.
Sam: dropping command snippets below for quick copy/paste:
```
# check cache memory and evictions
kubectl -n inference exec svc/cache-inspector -- redis-cli info memory | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'
# check model fallback status
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks | jq .current
# trigger safe fallback (non-destructive)
curl -X POST https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks/trigger -d '{"mode":"graceful"}'
```
Ashley: Note: last forced fallback caused transient higher latency because other pools were cold. We need a 'safety check' before trigger.
Priya: propose adding a preflight: ensure spare capacity > 10% and check recent 1m error rate < 1% before triggering fallback. I'll add exact prometheus queries.
Oliver: I'll wrap the fallback POST in a small wrapper script that runs the preflight checks and acquires a file lock. Will put it in infra-scripts repo.
Neha: owners: Runbook edits -> Neha; First-5-min checklist -> Oliver; Fallback wrapper script -> Oliver; Safety preflight queries and Grafana panels -> Ashley + Priya; Rollout coordination -> Sam.
Sam: adding due dates in the tracker: runbook PR by 2024-06-07, script by 2024-06-05, safety validation by 2024-06-06.
Neha: adding an explicit escalation ladder to the runbook: 1) page eng-oncall, 2) if no ack in 3m escalate to eng-sre, 3) if service error rate > 5% for 10m -> page infra-leads.
Priya: suggestion: include a carve-out for capacity-constrained regions (APAC) — faster escalation to regional SREs.
Oliver: will add the actual commands to page oncall (pagerduty trigger example) and a 'what to expect' blurb so oncall knows if it's safe to run fallback.
Ashley: I'll validate queries and runbook language for safety and sign off before PR merge.
Sam: can we add a quarterly recurring audit to verify playbook accuracy for cache-related incidents? Seems pattern repeats.
Neha: done, added recurring task to 'playbook-audit' board. Tagging 'recurring-incidents'.
Sam: created action items in postmortem tracker: https://go/repo/actions/98765. I'll follow up with calendar check-in next week.
IncidentBot: Follow-up meeting scheduled by Sam for 2024-06-10 09:30 (invite sent).
Priya: thanks, will bring capacity numbers and the Prom queries to the check-in.
Oliver: will open PR for checklist draft today and link it here when ready.
Neha: once PR is up I'll assign reviewers and confirm owners in the tracker :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks everyone — aim to close remediation items within two sprints."
